notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Scurry Oak.
You control another creature to sacrifice.
description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Squirrel token, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
